summary: Coverage is limited to the selected Item 1 Operating Segments subsection of Microsoft's FY2025 10-K: the three reportable segments, the named business groups and platforms listed under each, and the named subsets (cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, Azure AI offerings, Azure Security). Competitors are not modeled as Microsoft businesses. Customer, monetization and competition attributes are deferred in this graph stage.

businesses.name: MICROSOFT CORPORATION
businesses.description: Microsoft operates its business and reports its financial performance using three segments.

excerpts.quote: MICROSOFT CORPORATION
We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

businesses.name: Productivity and Business Processes
businesses.description: Segment of products and services in the productivity, communication, and information services portfolio, spanning a variety of devices and platforms.

excerpts.quote: Productivity and Business Processes

Our Productivity and Business Processes segment consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms.

businesses.name: Intelligent Cloud
businesses.description: Segment of public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers.

excerpts.quote: Intelligent Cloud
Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers.
